## How was it tested? / 如何测试

<!-- Godot version, steps you tried, and results. / Godot 版本、测试步骤和结果。 -->

- [ ] Tried the change in the editor / 在编辑器中实际操作过
- [ ] `Ctrl + Z` / `Ctrl + Y` undo and redo correctly / 撤销和重做正常
- [ ] Saved and reopened the scene; nothing unexpected was saved or lost / 保存并重新打开场景，没有多存或丢失内容

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] Static types everywhere, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/qwqzhanqwq/Godot-CSG-Blockout/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) / 全部静态类型，符合贡献指南的代码规范
- [ ] New UI text goes through `CsgBlockoutI18n` with all 7 languages / 新增界面文字走 `CsgBlockoutI18n`，7 种语言齐全
- [ ] User-visible change added under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` / 用户可见的改动已写入 `CHANGELOG.md` 的 `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Docs updated in both languages (if behavior changed) / 行为有变时，中英文文档都已更新
- [ ] Screenshot or clip attached (for UI/viewport changes) / UI 或视口改动已附截图或短视频
